text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Syrian newspapers on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Egyptian foreign minister Moussa says Cairo's ties with Syria, Lebanon strong.
- Israel reportedly to close Hebron deal with Palestinians.
- Israeli infrastructure minister Sharon for expanding Golan settlements.
- Israeli President Weizman: Israel seeks to keep footing in West Bank town of Hebron.
- China's parliament approves appointment of a new minister in charge of guiding defence technology.
- Arabs welcome outcome of meetings of Damascus declaration foreign ministers.
- Israel deports agent Lahd, commander of south Lebanon's army, to France.
- Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu rejects Palestinian state.
